draft_spec.description: Photo draft (all dimensions ESTIMATED) of team 1658X's VEX V5RC robot: omni-wheel tank base, tall tilted chain conveyor intake with red 84T gears, two rear towers. Sizes assume it fills most of the 18 in V5RC starting size; motor count and gearing are not visible and are guesses.
